description: The LUZAR LRc 19160 non—collapsible (soldered) aluminum radiator is manufactured using advanced KNOCKOUT technology. As a result of processing, a package of flat-oval tubes and corrugated tape turns into a durable all-metal core; the last stage of radiator production is the connection of the core to the tanks. Advantages for the consumer: After production, 100% of radiators undergo an outlet leak test under excessive pressure. All products fully comply with the requirements of the manufacturers: - thermal and dynamic properties – heat transfer, aerodynamic and hydraulic resistance. - according to geometric parameters – geometry, size of the cooling core, seating. Scope of application: An ideal solution for many modern domestic and imported vehicles, where a balance of cost, reliability and efficiency of the cooling system is important. description: The LUZAR LRc 26114 non—collapsible (soldered) aluminum radiator is manufactured using advanced KNOCKOUT technology. Manufactured using a unique technology of soldering in a nitrogen environment, they are characterized by exceptional strength, compactness and the highest heat dissipation. Compatible with: BMW 5 F10/F11/F07 (10-), 7 F01/F02 (08-), 6 F12/F13/F06 (11-), 5, 6, 7. The selection by the VIN number of your car is done via the "Ask a question" button. A specialist will check the applicability and respond to you. Design and key features: The production technology includes the stages of core assembly, fluxing and soldering, preheating, soldering in a nitrogen environment and instant cooling. As a result of processing, a package of flat-oval tubes and corrugated tape turns into a durable all-metal core; the last stage of radiator production is the connection of the core to the tanks. Advantages for the consumer: After production, 100% of radiators undergo an outlet leak test under excessive pressure. All products fully comply with the requirements of the manufacturers: - thermal and dynamic properties – heat transfer, aerodynamic and hydraulic resistance. - according to geometric parameters – geometry, size of the cooling core, seating. All products have certificates of conformity. Scope of application: An ideal solution for many modern domestic and imported vehicles, where a balance of cost, reliability and efficiency of the cooling system is important. title: Cooling radiator for Toyota Land Cruiser 200 4.5TD
description: The LUZAR LRc 1924 non—collapsible (soldered) aluminum radiator is manufactured using advanced KNOCKER technology. Manufactured using a unique technology of soldering in a nitrogen environment, they are characterized by exceptional strength, compactness and the highest heat dissipation. Compatible with: Toyota Land Cruiser 200 (07-), LAND CRUISER. The selection by the VIN number of your car is done via the "Ask a question" button. A specialist will check the applicability and respond to you. Design and key features: The production technology includes the stages of core assembly, fluxing and soldering, preheating, soldering in a nitrogen environment and instant cooling. As a result of processing, a package of flat-oval tubes and corrugated tape turns into a durable all-metal core; the last stage of radiator production is the connection of the core to the tanks. Advantages for the consumer: After production, 100% of radiators undergo an outlet leak test under excessive pressure. All products fully comply with the requirements of the manufacturers: - thermal and dynamic properties – heat transfer, aerodynamic and hydraulic resistance. - according to geometric parameters – geometry, size of the cooling core, seating. All products have certificates of conformity. Scope of application: An ideal solution for many modern domestic and imported vehicles, where a balance of cost, reliability and efficiency of the cooling system is important. title: Mazda 6 GJ M A Cooling Radiator
description: The LUZAR LRc 251PE non—collapsible (soldered) aluminum radiator is manufactured using advanced KNOCKOUT technology. Manufactured using a unique technology of soldering in a nitrogen environment, they are characterized by exceptional strength, compactness and the highest heat dissipation. Compatible with: Mazda 6 (13-), 6. Selection by the VIN number of your car - via the "Ask a question" button. A specialist will check the applicability and respond to you. Design and key features: The production technology includes the stages of core assembly, fluxing and soldering, preheating, soldering in a nitrogen environment and instant cooling. As a result of processing, a package of flat-oval tubes and corrugated tape turns into a durable all-metal core; the last stage of radiator production is the connection of the core to the tanks. Advantages for the consumer: After production, 100% of radiators undergo an outlet leak test under excessive pressure. All products fully comply with the requirements of the manufacturers: - thermal and dynamic properties – heat transfer, aerodynamic and hydraulic resistance. - according to geometric parameters – geometry, size of the cooling core, seating. All products have certificates of conformity. Scope of application: An ideal solution for many modern domestic and imported vehicles, where a balance of cost, reliability and efficiency of the cooling system is important. As a result of processing, a package of flat-oval tubes and corrugated tape turns into a durable all-metal core; the last stage of radiator production is the connection of the core to the tanks. Advantages for the consumer: After production, 100% of radiators undergo an outlet leak test under excessive pressure. All products fully comply with the requirements of the manufacturers: - thermal and dynamic properties – heat transfer, aerodynamic and hydraulic resistance. - according to geometric parameters – geometry, size of the cooling core, seating. All products have certificates of conformity. Scope of application: An ideal solution for many modern domestic and imported vehicles, where a balance of cost, reliability and efficiency of the cooling system is important. description: The LUZAR LRc 08125 non—collapsible (soldered) aluminum radiator is manufactured using advanced KNOCKOUT technology. Compatible with: Hyundai Sonata VII (14-), SONATA. The selection by the VIN number of your car is done via the "Ask a question" button. A specialist will check the applicability and respond to you. Design and key features: The production technology includes the stages of core assembly, fluxing and soldering, preheating, soldering in a nitrogen environment and instant cooling. As a result of processing, a package of flat-oval tubes and corrugated tape turns into a durable all-metal core; the last stage of radiator production is the connection of the core to the tanks. Advantages for the consumer: After production, 100% of radiators undergo an outlet leak test under excessive pressure. All products fully comply with the requirements of the manufacturers: - thermal and dynamic properties – heat transfer, aerodynamic and hydraulic resistance. - according to geometric parameters – geometry, size of the cooling core, seating. All products have certificates of conformity. Scope of application: An ideal solution for many modern domestic and imported vehicles, where a balance of cost, reliability and efficiency of the cooling system is important.
